name: fmp_commodity_quote
description:
Latest quote for one commodity (gold, oil, silver and others) from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP).
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/commodity-quote as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): symbol* (FMP commodity symbol, e.g. GCUSD for gold).
For symbols use fmp_commodity_list; for history fmp_commodity_historical.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {"symbol": "GCUSD"}

symbol.description: FMP commodity symbol (e.g. GCUSD for gold)
